mapper.select: select * from ES_SLP_BASE order by XH
mapper.insert: insert into ES_SLP_BASE (ID, XH, SLP_NAME, AREA, HH_AREA, STCD_LIST, STNM_LIST, YJ_SW, C_SW, XJJ_SW, BZ_SW, FORMULA_A, FORMULA_B, FORMULA_C, REMARK, MODITIME) values (#{ID}, #{XH}, #{SLP_NAME}, #{AREA}, #{HH_AREA}, #{STCD_LIST}, #{STNM_LIST}, #{YJ_SW}, #{C_SW}, #{XJJ_SW}, #{BZ_SW}, #{FORMULA_A}, #{FORMULA_B}, #{FORMULA_C}, #{REMARK}, sysdate)
